newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Manuel silent on S.Africa forex control relaxation.
newsitem.headline: Manuel silent on S.Africa forex control relaxation.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel on Thursday declined to answer questions on government plans for relaxing foreign exchange controls.

"I won't entertain any speculation on the issue," Manuel told reporters at a parliamentary briefing when asked to expand on an apparent hint on Wednesday that there would be an announcement in the March 12 budget.
Asked on Wednesday by Democratic Party MP Ken Andrew about the impact of the rand's recent strength on exchange control policy, Manuel replied:
"In view of the appreciating value of the rand, I would invite the Honourable Andrew to have patience until Budget Day. There is exactly one month to Budget Day, let's not spoil our fun yet."
